model.note: The weights are not in the repository. They are in the l2048-forget archive of the release.
model.optimizer: Adam in the eigenbasis of each weight matrix's gradient moments, refreshed every 50 updates, the matrices of three-dimensional weights turned as well
model.training_windows: 512 bytes in batches of 8 up to 24,000 updates, then 2,048 bytes in batches of 2 with a read reach of 2,048 cells; 4,096 targets an update throughout

forked_at.from: p-forget, v15's recipe with --read-forget on windows of 512 bytes

architecture.stack: eleven levels, each a state read of 8 heads and then a layer of 1,188 threshold cells, both writing their spikes back into one stream of 512 channels
architecture.forgetting: every read head learns a slope: a cell beyond the window takes the oldest age's offset plus the slope times the doublings of its age beyond the window

model.paths_note: Replaced on 2026-11-22: the released file is the scored file with two training arguments, results_dir and checkpoint, rewritten to repository paths; its weights are identical.

l2048-flat.note: the same fork with the slopes held at zero

tf2048.note: the reference Transformer on windows of 2,048 bytes, 34,752,000 parameters

tf1024.note: the Transformer on windows of 1,024 bytes
